cards.audioText: [Your call sign is UAL887, destination Hong Kong, over POLHO 20, level 10100m, estimate TMR 45, next TZH, contact Beijing Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是UAL（美联航）887，目的地香港，过POLHO 20分，高度10100米，预计TMR 45分，下个报告点TZH，联系北京区调。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, UAL887, 10100m maintaining, POLHO 20, estimate TMR 45, next TZH.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，美联航887，101000米保持，POLHO 20分，预计TMR 45分，下个报告点TZH。

cards.audioText: UAL887, Beijing Control, recycle squawk 0036.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航887，北京区调，转换到应答机0036。
cards.referenceText: Squawk 0036, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 应答机0036，美联航887。

cards.audioText: [A flight attendant reports that a pregnant woman is about to give birth.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【乘务员报告一位孕妇即将生产。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Beijing Control, UAL887, a pregnant woman on board is about to give birth.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，北京区调，美联航887，机上一位孕妇即将生产。

cards.audioText: UAL887 roger, turn right heading 140, radar vector for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航887，收到，右转航向140，雷达引导着陆。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 140, radar vector for landing, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向140，雷达引导着陆，美联航887。

cards.audioText: [15 minutes later.] [Tell ATC that the baby is delivered safely, but the mother has fainted, request landing as soon as possible.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【15分钟后】【告诉ATC孩子平安出生，但母亲已经昏迷，请求尽快着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, UAL887, baby has been delivered safely, but the woman lost consciousness, request landing as soon as possible.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，美联航887，孩子平安出生，但母亲失去意识，请求尽快着陆。

cards.audioText: UAL887, roger, ambulance and doctor will be ready on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航887，收到，救护车和医生将在到达后就位。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，美联航887。

cards.audioText: UAL887, direct to HUR, descend to and maintain 3600m, contact Beijing Approach 119.7.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航887，直飞HUR，下降保持3600米，联系北京进近119.7。
cards.referenceText: Direct to HUR, descend to and maintain 3600m, 119.7, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞HUR，下降保持3600米，119.7，美联航887。

cards.audioText: [You are descending to 3600m, contact Beijing Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已下降到3600米，联系北京进近。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, UAL887, descending to 3600m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，美联航887，下降到3600米。

cards.audioText: UAL887, Beijing Approach, descend to 1800m on QNH, QNH 1011, expect runway 01, information H.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航887，北京进近，下降到修正海压1800米，修正海压1011，预计跑道01，通播H。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 1800m on QNH, QNH 1011, expect runway 01, information H, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到修正海压1800米，修正海压1011，预计跑道01，通播H，美联航887。

cards.audioText: UAL887, turn right heading 170, radar vector for landing.[Adverse weather is en route, request heading 190.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航887，右转航向170，雷达引导着陆。【途中出现恶劣天气，请求航向190。】
cards.referenceText: Request turn right heading 190 due weather, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于恶劣天气，请求右转航向190，美联航887。

cards.audioText: UAL887, turn right heading 190 approved.[Report cleared of weather, request heading 300 for final.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航，同意右转航向190。【报告已经远离天气，请求航向300加入五边。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, UAL887, cleared of weather, request heading 300 for final.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，美联航887，远离天气，请求航向300加入五边。

cards.audioText: UAL887, negative, due to restricted area, if able, turn right heading 280 initially.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航887，由于限飞区不同意，如可能初始右转航向280。
cards.referenceText: Initial turn right heading 280, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 初始右转航向280，美联航887。

cards.audioText: UAL887, continue turn right heading 340 intercept localizer runway 01, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航887，继续右转航向340，切入跑道01航道，建立报告。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 340 intercept localizer runway 01, report established, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向340，切入01航道，建立航道报，美联航887。

cards.audioText: [You have established localizer.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已经建立航道。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, UAL887, established localizer.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，美联航887，建立航道。

cards.audioText: UAL887, continue approach, contact Beijing Tower 118.1.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航887，继续进近，联系北京塔台118.1。
cards.referenceText: Continue approach, 118.1, thanks, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近，118.1，谢谢，美联航887。

cards.audioText: [Report to Tower that you have established ILS.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【报告塔台你已经建立盲降。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, UAL887, established ILS.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，美联航887，建立盲降。

cards.audioText: UAL887, Beijing Tower, continue approach, report outer marker, caution low cloud and rain in this area.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航887，北京塔台，继续进近，到外信标台报告，注意区域内低云和雨。
cards.referenceText: Continue approach, report outer marker, thanks, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近，到外信标台报告，谢谢，美联航887。

cards.audioText: [Over outer marker.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【到达外信标台上方。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, UAL887, outer marker.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，美联航887，外信标台。

cards.audioText: UAL887, cleared to land runway 01, surface wind 160, 7m/s, report vacated.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航887，可以着陆01，地面风160, 7m/s，脱离后报告。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land runway 01, report vacated, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以在跑道01着陆，脱离后报告，美联航887。

cards.audioText: [When you are landing, tail strike occurs, request assistance from Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【着陆时飞机擦机尾，向塔台请求援助。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, UAL887, tail strike when landing, request emergency assistance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，美联航887，着陆时擦机尾，请求紧急援助。

cards.audioText: Roger, UAL887, maintenance will arrive soon.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，美联航887，维修人员会马上到达。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，美联航887。
